snippet.title: Pokemon Black and White 3: Genesis (Rom Hack) | Full Game Playthrough
snippet.description:
Full playthrough of the Pokemon Crystal rom hack, Black and White 3: Genesis. Below is a list of timestamps of important events. 

If you want to download the game yourself, as well as any other rom hacks, please go to the description of my pokemon rom hack playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLrQF7D6-m_uiSx0ZzTO8xROnjzHwF0udq

Lacunosa Town - 13:26
Five Undella Town Trainers challenge - 54:02
Humilau City Gym - 1:06:08
Reversal Mountain - 1:12:00
Getting HM01 Cut - 1:28:18
Lentimas Town Gym - 1:47:47
Lostlorn Forest - 1:56:25
Relic Castle - 2:26:04
Castelia City Gym - 3:06:07
EXP Share - 3:18:51
Bicycle - 3:21:59
Coin Case - 3:23:17
Team Plasma in Nimbasa City (Rail Pass) - 3:27:39
Team Plasma in Virbank Complex (HM02 Fly) - 4:30:29
Virbank City Gym - 4:45:14
Aspertia City Gym - 5:12:10
Striaton City Gym - 6:33:26
Retrieving the Data Disk - 6:54:10
Nuvema Town (HM03 Surf) - 7:01:29
Stopping Team Plasma in P2 Lab - 7:15:55
Wellspring Cave - 7:28:34
Castelia Sewers (HM04 Strength) - 7:40:07
Larvesta - 8:04:41
World Tournament (HM05 Waterfall and Masterball) 8:10:25
Mistralton Cave - 9:02:00
Chargestone Cave - 9:10:04
Getting Skyla and Mistralton City Gym - 9:26:16
Celestial Tower - 9:50:23
Team Plasma at Seaside Cave - 9:56:34
Village Bridge - 10:11:10
Dragonspiral Tower - 11:26:51
Opelucid City Gym - 12:07:10
Victory Road - 12:28:20
Elite Four, Genesect Project, Juniper Battle, Ending #1 - 13:32:06
(Post Game Starts) N - 14:19:38
Catching Genesect - 14:26:23
Alder - 14:34:09
Iris - 14:41:24
Caitlin and Cynthia - 14:48:16
Hugh - 15:00:53
Rood - 15:07:48
Nate - 15:14:22
Hilbert - 15:21:43

Note: This was my first time playing the game, so alot of things that were not fully obvious to me at the time I played the game. Most notably was some of the evolution changes. I could have evolved Roselia much sooner since it evolves through leaf stone in this game rather than shiny stone (not in this game). So I do apologize for stuff like that. Also, this game was played late April 2023, so regardless if this game does or doesnt get updated in the future, I probably won't return to it, as I do feel very pleased with the coverage that I did of this game and the amount of content in this version of it. Lastly, and speaking of content, much credit to the youtuber Genoci for showing off the post game battles and how to get them.
